description: A purple hook with one pale ridge of light down the curve, and a hard green crust dried on the last third of the point.
lore: It grew where it sits — the one thing off an [[monsters/diablo|Ashfiend]] that did. Longer than a finger, curved well past use, the base a socket shaped around a knuckle that is not there any more. Hafted, it makes a poor knife every time, and people keep the poor knife, because a claw is worth little and a claw with a hand behind it is worth something.

The crust on the point is the part worth money: mustard at its base, hard green at the tip, sitting on the purple rather than in it. It was put there; it did not grow there. It flakes under a thumbnail, so the careful carry one point-down in a stiff wrap and wash afterwards.

[[characters/ef25b1f0|Bettany]] pays over the odds for a well-crusted one, and she is not buying knives. The same green comes off [[monsters/malformed_creature|the pale walking thing]] on the black rock, and two creatures' leavings agreeing about a pigment is the kind of sentence [[lore/the_chronicle|the Chronicle]] exists to catch. Whether this point put the green into something or drew it out, the crust will not say. She keeps her best one wrapped in linen inside a chapter that has no words in it yet — just the claw, and a heading: which way did it run.
